pieces.title: Inventory of Things I’m Not Sorry For

items.text: That I don’t always reply in the same hour, day, or mood you messaged me in.
That I cry during commercials but not at funerals.
That I said yes and then no.
That I walked out of a church halfway through because I disagreed with the sermon.
That I didn’t “lean in” at that toxic job, I leaned out, fell over, and quit by text.
That I still don’t like kale, your TED Talk, or being touched when I’m sad.

runs.text: Not for being complicated in public.
